ARM_A_BASELINE.description: Baseline RAG (Trust Control DISABLED, Abstention DEFAULT, Claim Verification DISABLED at runtime)

ARM_B_ADAPTIVE.description: Adaptive Trust-Aware RAG (Trust Control ENABLED, Abstention ENABLED, Claim Verification ENABLED at runtime)

metrics.claim_support_rate: Proportion of generated factual claims successfully verified against cited retrieved evidence.
metrics.citation_validation_rate: Proportion of generated citations mapping to valid retrieved chunks.
metrics.unsupported_answer_rate: Proportion of answers containing at least one UNSUPPORTED_OR_UNVERIFIED_CLAIM.
metrics.provider_failure_rate: Provider failures / total authorized provider requests.

failure_policy: retry=0, fallback=disabled, one attempt per case.
evaluation_methodology: Common Detached Post-Generation Evaluator for BOTH arms.
